reference: Oded Schramm, Israel Journal of Mathematics 118, 221 (2000), 'Scaling limits of loop-erased random walks and uniform spanning trees'. Charles Loewner's 1923 equation grows a curve into the upper half plane from a real driving function; Schramm showed that the only conformally invariant random curves with the domain Markov property come from driving it with Brownian motion of variance κ, and identified κ with the critical models whose interfaces they describe. Gregory Lawler, Schramm and Wendelin Werner computed the exponents; Stanislav Smirnov proved the percolation case. The curve is computed here as a composition of vertical slit maps, after Tom Kennedy, Journal of Statistical Physics 137, 839 (2009).
equation: ∂g_t/∂t = 2 / (g_t(z) − √κ B_t),   γ(t) = g_t⁻¹(√κ B_t);   κ = 2 loop-erased walk, 8/3 self-avoiding walk, 4 level lines, 6 percolation, 8 Peano curve
limitations: The trace dimension disagrees with Beffara's min(2, 1 + kappa/8) at every tested point: at the tab's maximum N 8000 box counting gives 1.2236 +/- 0.0063 (kappa 2, -4.2 sigma), 1.3765 +/- 0.0076 (kappa 4, -16 sigma) and 1.4780 +/- 0.0055 (kappa 6, -50 sigma), rising slowly with N. The estimator recovers known dimensions on Koch curves of comparable size, so the shortfall is the uniform-capacity-time discretization of the tab's trace, not the driver or the model.

Numerical agreement is established for the Loewner solver (zero, linear and square-root drivers, first order in dt, N 300-8000) and for the driver variance (kappa 2, 4, 6); the random curve's law beyond its box-counting dimension is not tested.
Print evidence covers five recipes (kappa 2, 6, 8, the sweep and a 12-seed bundle) on one Chromium build; kappa values other than 2, 4, 6 appear only in print recipes.
Finite samples from one seeded PRNG; error bars assume independent seeds.
remaining: Resolve the trace finely enough for its fractal dimension to converge (adaptive capacity steps or a much larger N, as in Kennedy 2009), then repeat the box-counting test; or state in the tab that the plate is a coarse discretization whose dimension is below 1 + kappa/8.
Test a distributional property of the trace (for example Schramm's left-passage probability) at kappa 8/3 and 6.
Extend the dimension ensemble to kappa 8/3 and 8 once the resolution is adequate.

numerical.scope: Module makeTrace against closed-form traces for xi = 0, c t (c 2, -3, 0.5) and c sqrt t (alpha 1/4, 1/3, 0.4, 0.6) with N 300-8000 at capacity time 1; quadratic variation of the module's driver over 16 seeds for kappa 2, 4, 6 at N 2000-8000; box-counting dimension over the same ensembles with a fixed relative fit range and a Koch-curve calibration of the estimator.
numerical.criteria: Zero driver relative error <= N eps; linear error <= |c| dt at every point with order in (0.9, 1.1); square-root relative error <= 1/N at t = 1 with order in (0.9, 1.1) and scale covariance to 1e-9; driver QV/kappa within |z| < 3.86; dimension within |z| < 3.59 of 1 + kappa/8 (fails).
numerical.benchmark: Exact Loewner traces (vertical segment; Kager-Nienhuis-Kadanoff linear-driver curve; straight-ray square-root driver), exact Brownian quadratic variation, Beffara's dimension theorem, and generalized Koch curves of known dimension for the estimator.
numerical.failureControl: Slit capacity dt instead of 2 dt (zero-driver error 0.29); reversed composition order (linear error 2473 driver steps); driver variance 2 kappa (dimension shifts +0.159 and +0.193, 19 and 20 sigma; QV ratio 2.00).
numerical.limitations: The dimension test disagrees with theory at N <= 8000 because of the discretization; only the solver and driver agree with their exact references.

print.scope: Five studio recipes through dist/studio.html with an auditRead() hook at 2400 px on the long side: every SVG path vertex, axis and stroke attribute, the fallback PNG, a displaced control, and recipe and traces before and after export.
print.criteria: Studio drivers within 1e-12 and traces within 1e-9 of the curve size of the Node run; trace recomputed from the studio driver; SVG coordinates within 0.00501 px and every ink equal; PNG channels within 1 of an independent painting; displaced painting fails; state unchanged.
print.benchmark: Page transform, segmenting and inks rebuilt independently in the page from the traces.
print.failureControl: One-pixel displaced painting must differ on at least 100 channels (it differs on 62,159 to 604,069).
print.limitations: Five recipes, one Chromium build; the vector RIP raster is recorded, not asserted.

domain.parameters: Solver: capacity time 1, N 300-8000, deterministic drivers listed in validation/SLE.md; driver and dimension: kappa 2, 4, 6 at N 2000, 4000, 8000 with 16 seeds each; prints: the five recipes in validation/results/sle-science.json.
domain.conditions: Chordal Loewner evolution in the upper half plane from 0, piecewise-constant driver sampled at step ends, Brownian driver of variance kappa from the recorded seeds; no grain; exports preserve recipe and traces.
domain.resolution: dt = 1/N; box counts at eps = D 2^{-k/2}, k 8-14, D the curve diameter; prints 2400 x 1920, 1920 x 2400, 2400 x 1600 and 2400 x 2400 px.
domain.precision: Binary64 solver and references; RGBA8 raster; SVG rounded to 0.01 px; Node and Chromium versions recorded.
